steps.content: You walk along the beach, your sandals sinking into the fine sand with a soft rustling sound—a completely different experience from walking on WhiteSands.
The salty breeze fills your nostrils as you gaze into the distance at an ocean much like the one around Elysiland.
Of course, there's also... the smell of barbecue.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Squid, saury, mackerel! Fresh from the sea, hot off the grill!

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: One bite and you'll be back for more! Guaranteed fresh, or you get your money back tenfold!

Following the shouts, you spot a large wooden plank from a wrecked fishing boat with "Surf's Bounty" scrawled across it. Tables and stools of different sizes are scattered nearby. The boss and her staff are bustling around the grill, while off to the side stands... a bookkeeper.

steps.speaker: Customer
steps.content: One grilled eel for me, please.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Alrighty! Want it spicy?

steps.speaker: Customer
steps.content: Sure! The hotter the better.

steps.speaker: Grill Master
steps.content: Copy.
The grill master moves fast. She yanks an eel from a bucket, scrapes the scales off with a few casual flicks of her knife, and slaps it onto a salt-covered cutting board.

After rubbing it in salt for a few minutes, she flashes her blade, creating a clean cut around the gills. In one smooth motion, she peels off the skin and slime, a slick move that draws gasps from the watching diners.

steps.speaker: Customer
steps.content: ...Show-off. Gutting the eel is the tricky part.

steps.speaker: Grill Master
steps.content: We'll see about that.
The grill master doesn't miss a beat. She slits the belly, lifts the organs with her fingertips, and nudges them toward the head.
With three lightning-fast cuts, the innards are effortlessly removed, perfectly intact.

steps.speaker: Customer
steps.content: That's... impossible. I've cooked eel for ten years, never seen anyone do it like that...
It's so reckless. He knows how awful a burst gallbladder tastes, which is why he's spent years carefully scooping the innards out with a spoon.

While the man questions his career, the grill master is already pinning the fillet down. Her blade moves as if it has a mind of its own, sliding along the spine to sever bone from flesh without piercing the meat, deboning the entire thing in one go.
The man rubs his eyes. Surely he's seeing things. This isn't your average freshwater eel. It's a sea eel, far bonier and much more difficult to prepare.
He opens his mouth, but finds he has no words. The spine has been removed, but the fillet is flawless.

The grill master dusts off her hands and moves on to the final step. She slices the fillet, plucking the stray bones as she goes. A brush of sauce, a sizzle on the grill, and the rich aroma of fish fills the air.
The eel's tail is still twitching on the cutting board, while the knife has already been returned to its rack.

steps.speaker: Grill Master
steps.content: Enjoy.

steps.speaker: Everyone
steps.content: I'll have one too!
The crowd erupts, enthralled by her divine knifework and cooking.

steps.speaker: Everyone
steps.content: One for me as well!

steps.speaker: Customer
steps.content: Daddy, is that lady a magician?

steps.speaker: Customer
steps.content: Hahaha, she's no magician, sweetheart.

steps.speaker: Customer
steps.content: She's Daddy's teacher now.
More and more people are drawn in, the tide of bodies pushing you forward.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Hold it, hold it! One at a time! Our bookkeeper can't keep up with this many orders!

steps.speaker: Bookkeeper
steps.content: It doesn't matter. This volume doesn't even approach my processing limit.

Watching the endless line of customers and her two capable employees, the boss of the seaside barbecue place can't help but smirk to herself. Nothing beats sitting back and watching the money roll in.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Oops, sorry! We've just sold out of eel. How about something else? All our grilled fish is just as good!
She scratches the back of her head apologetically.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Who's this troublemaker? Haven't you heard of my...
The boss stomps toward you, grumbling under her breath. But the words die in her throat the moment you look up.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Haven't you heard of my diligence, hard work, and generous nature? Never mind one eel, I can get you ten if you want!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Hey, Jane! Come say hi to our Chief!
You turn toward the voice, just in time to see a smoke grenade fly through the air and bounce on the ground.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Grab the cash and run!
Smoke bursts out, throwing the tourists into confusion. Seizing the opportunity, Bai Yi grabs Jane, the grill master, and makes a run for it.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Mission aborted. Preparing to evacuate.
Jane zip-ties herself to Bai Yi's back. Once she's secure, Bai Yi strikes a dramatic pose, ready to activate her ability. The bookkeeper stands motionless, silently watching the farce.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Adios!
When Sinners get up to no good, you have DisCity's most effective disciplinary tool.
Red shackles materialize instantly. Bai Yi activates her ability, but she's a split second too slow. The shackles pin both of them to the ground.
Bai Yi is fast. If she hadn't wasted time showing off, she might have gotten away.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I mean... ah, do you feel tired? Maybe you could just let me sit down? I promise I won't run this time.
Always looking for a way out.
(Scene change)
When L.L. left, Elysiland vanished with her, leaving the entire space an empty void.
However, after the Eastside government took over the area, the Elysiland Renewal Project was launched.
With the MBCC's help using dark web technology, Elysiland was rebuilt and reopened to the public.
Soon, the place was bustling with more life than ever before.
But at its core, Elysiland still exists on <color=#fb9259>Mania</color>.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the M-Values in Elysiland are rising. Something is off.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The current theory is that the visitors' heightened emotions are reaching a saturation point, triggering a Mania reaction.
Of course, you already have a contingency plan for this. The Bureau has Sinners monitoring the area in shifts, with any anomalies to be reported immediately.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Jane, Dreya, and...
She hesitates, trailing off.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: And who else?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Bai Yi.
(Scene change)
The two of them sit meekly at the table. It's almost like they're undergoing an interrogation. All the customers have long since fled the premises.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Have you identified the origin of the Mania?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: But I sent our astronomer! Look, I figured I wouldn't be much help anyway. I can barely tell east from west. Better that I stay here. Besides...
Bai Yi clears her throat.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Blending in with the tourists is part of the mission! You know, hiding in plain sight, quietly observing from within the crowd. Sometimes you stumble on unexpected leads.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: So you've just been selling grilled fish here for days?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I didn't have a choice, Chief! Che and K.K. were both away on missions, and that debt collector showed up at my door again...
Bai Yi's eyes well up with tears, but you know better than to believe a single word coming out of her mouth.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: He said... he said if I don't pay up this month, he's going to pawn everything from Whitestone!

steps.speaker: Option
options: Might as well sell them. They're only taking up space in the Bureau Depot anyway.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Not gonna happen! I'm not selling them off for cheap. Every piece is a priceless memory of Whitestone!

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I understand the sentiment.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: That's my temp! I knew you'd get it!
In just a few days, Jane has already been bitten by the Whitestone bug.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: How did you end up as a temp for her?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Last week, I used a Type II Shell on a Corruptor. The shell was too powerful. It went straight through the target and blew up an uninhabited mansion in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: According to the regulations, I have to cover 75% of the damage.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I was at my wits' end when Ms. Bai came to my rescue.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: She gave me this job, and even half the earnings.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: She didn't ask any questions, just said she believed in my abilities... She's more like a friend than a boss.
It seems this is the first time in Jane's life she has ever felt this trusted.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Hehe, say, Jane, how about you come and work for Whitestone full-time? We desperately need someone as hardworking as you!
You can see the dollar signs in her eyes and quickly cut off the scheming capitalist.

steps.speaker: Option
options: What have you been doing besides selling barbecue?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Ah, well...

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Performing, finding missing persons, putting up posters, handing out flyers, and fishing. I'd never done most of these things before, but it's fun doing them with a friend.
Bai Yi opens her mouth, but her star employee has already spilled all the beans. She lunges to cover Jane's mouth, terrified of what else she might reveal.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Ahem... We may not look like it, but we've made some real progress!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Our astronomer can tell you about it.
Snap.
The ledger snaps shut. A scholar in a white blouse removes her grease-proof apron and comes over to you.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: I have some preliminary findings regarding this incident.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: The Mania is affecting this space in an unusual way.
She looks up, gazing toward the horizon. Twilight is silently spreading across the sky, even though the sun was high in the sky when you first arrived.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: It's disrupting the tidal patterns, making the nights last longer than they should. I can't pinpoint the origin of the Mania yet. We'll need wider observations.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: However, after the rebuild, 90% of this area is now seawater. Exploring the other zones has become difficult. We'll likely need some kind of watercraft.
The scholar looks troubled. The barbecue boss, meanwhile, lights up.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: A watercraft? Leave it to me!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Hah...
She takes a deep breath, and a flash of white light cuts the "Surf's Bounty" sign from its post, sending it crashing to the ground.
The weathered sign breaks in half, but the sharp-eyed Jane spots something immediately.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Look!
A silver surfboard slides out from the broken sign. Bai Yi scoops it up and twirls it with a flourish.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: How about that? Whitestone's prized surfboard! I hid it in here so it wouldn't get lost!

options: I don't even know where to begin.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: It takes you to places, doesn't it?
Just as you're considering requesting a proper boat from the Bureau, Dreya walks right up to Bai Yi and takes the surfboard from her.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: For now, this is our most practical, and indeed our best, tool.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Well, if our astronomer says so, there's no time to waste!
Bai Yi waves everyone over. Dreya, however, walks directly to you.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Chief, do you know how to surf?
